blocks.text: A home network is used to connect different devices in a house. It helps computers, mobile phones, and printers to communicate with each other. All devices can share the same internet connection. A router is the main device in a home network. Network setup makes data sharing easy and fast. Proper configuration improves network speed and safety.

A home network has different important components. A router connects all devices in the network. A modem connects the home network to the internet service provider. Computers, laptops, and mobile phones are network devices. Network cables are used for wired connections. Wireless devices use Wi-Fi signals to connect.

A wired network uses cables to connect devices. Ethernet cables are commonly used in wired networks. Devices are connected directly to a router or switch. Wired connections provide high speed and stable performance. These networks are more secure than wireless networks. However, devices cannot move freely because of cables.

A wireless network connects devices without using cables. It uses radio signals to send and receive data. Wi-Fi is the most common wireless technology used in homes. Devices can move freely within the network range. Wireless networks are easy to install and use. They may be slower than wired networks in some cases.
